newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 13.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Head of State Council's securities committee Zhou Zhengqing calls for standardisation of financial markets and strengthening of measures to control risk.
- Shanghai Video and Audio Electric (Group) Co has been restructured as part of process of encouraging the establishment of modern enterprises in the city.
- BUSINESS NEWS - New policies on housing to be implementred in Shanghai this year to further reform the assigned housing system.
- Shanghai Aeronatics Bureau to enter satellite launch business.
- Shanghai city signs agreement with IBM on cooperation on technology projects.
- Yanan Road East elevated highway to open to traffic in December.
